card.name: Lists of taxa and benzodiazepine co-use
card.fires_on: Commas, 'and', 'or' and 'including' inside a list of plant family names, and linking words right after 'benzodiazepines' in opioid co-use warnings. Also the start of 'Interactions' after a section number.

modes.label: Plant family lists
modes.description: Commas and 'and' between Latin plant family names ending in -aceae.
modes.example: most of the species are in Orchidaceae<<,>> Bromeliaceae, Araceae

modes.label: Benzodiazepine co-use wording
modes.description: Linking words after 'benzodiazepines' or before 'alcohol' in warnings about CNS depressants.
modes.example: CNS depressants (<<including>> alcohol and illicit drugs). Advise patients

modes.label: Interactions heading
modes.description: The 'Inter' piece of 'Interference' or 'Interactions' in a numbered section heading 7.1.
modes.example: 7 DRUG INTERACTIONS 7.1<< Inter>>ference with Rapid Antigen Detection RSV
